name: surogate-desktop
description: Surogate Desktop: lets an agent's tools work on a folder of your computer.

scripts.build: scripts/node.sh && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.pages.json && mkdir -p dist/shell/pages dist/browser/observe && cp src/shell/pages/*.html src/shell/pages/*.css dist/shell/pages/ && cp ../surogates/browser/observe/*.js dist/browser/observe/
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run agent-disk && electron dist/shell/main.js
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && sh test/isolated.sh vitest run --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run agent-disk && xvfb-run -a vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts
